svg.title: PSI COMP 80 PCB artwork
svg.desc: Main board copper artwork. The red and blue layers are traced from a photo of the kit's artwork sheet (approximate); pads, key legends and outline are redrawn from the placement data.
svg.text: PSI COMP 80 (Wireless World 1979) - main board artwork; copper traced from a photo, approximate
board 16 in x 12 in (crop marks) - 1 in = 125 units
